components.name: Print summary
components.description: Print selected tests across as many A4 pages as needed. The summary allows page breaks and visible overflow; individual test markers avoid splitting across pages. Charts remain 88px high and source details 9px.

components.name: Upload status error
components.description: Written upload errors explain what to try next.
components.html: Connection lost. Check your connection and try again.

components.name: Source page control
components.description: Opens the original report at the page containing a recorded value.

components.name: Report-date value slot
components.description: Two or three reports, with an optional third. Missing values and different units are explicit; charts stop at missing dates. Change labels show the first and last available dates.
components.html:
18 Sep 2025

No matching value in this report

components.name: Health category blocks
components.description: Four desktop columns become two on phones. Pressed blocks show test counts and filter comparable results, unpaired results and test choices by selecting all tests in that category and clearing other selections. Tests may belong to multiple groups; Other is the fallback. Empty groups say no tests are available. Common Indian lab groups are supported, not exhaustive categorization. Category controls are excluded from print.

components.name: Test picker
components.description: Choose zero or any number of available tests without a six-test cap. The count reads N selected; Select none clears selections. Picker controls are excluded from print.
components.html: Choose tests for your summary 0 selected
components.css: .ds-test-picker{font-family:'Public Sans',sans-serif;margin-bottom:24px}.ds-test-picker summary{cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:#174e65;padding:12px 0;line-height:1.5}.ds-test-picker summary span{font-size:12px;font-weight:400;margin-left:12px;color:#526977}.ds-select-none{background:white;border:1px solid #a7bfca;border-radius:7px;color:#174e65;font:500 13px 'Public Sans',sans-serif;padding:11px 15px;cursor:pointer}.ds-select-none:hover{background:#e5eef3}.ds-test-picker summary:focus-visible,.ds-select-none:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #c17824;outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-test-picker summary span{display:block;margin-left:0}}@media print{.ds-test-picker{display:none!important}}

narrative.overview: The summary is a reading surface used by patients and doctors during a visit. Paired results sit beneath each chart, with source links beside the evidence.
dos: Do show source links beside every value.
donts: Don't label measured changes as health improving or worsening.
